lshw_gtk_quiet.description: Whether to suppress non-essential output or run in a background mode.

lshw_output_format.description: Default output format for lshw if exported from the GUI, one of: html, xml, json, short.

lshw_log_file.description: Path to a log file for capturing application output or errors.

lshw_save_state.description: Whether to remember the last viewed hardware state or window geometry.

lshw_classes.description: List of hardware classes to filter display for. Empty list shows all.
